fusions.name: Tail Lash
fusions.desc: A whipping turn that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles of you and knocks them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Cold Snap Bite
fusions.desc: Snaps out at the first enemy ahead of you at or below 30% health, which deals 22 damage and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. It can only strike a target that low.

fusions.name: Basking Stillness
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed and Regrow
fusions.desc: When your health falls low, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
